name: i6-share
description: Local-network file sharing between a phone PWA and a dashboard-scoped Native AOT .NET hub.

scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run native:lint && npm run native:test && npm run native:coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run type-coverage && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.native:build: npm run native:lines && dotnet build native/I6Share.slnx -warnaserror
scripts.native:test: tsx tools/cli.ts clean:native-coverage && dotnet test native/I6Share.slnx -warnaserror --settings native/coverage.runsettings --results-directory artifacts/native-coverage
scripts.native:lint: npm run native:build && dotnet format native/I6Share.slnx --verify-no-changes --no-restore --severity info
